title: Orsen and the Sigil
author: Rosalind Ashgrove
blurb: Tamsin Eastwick, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
